welcome.speaker: crier
welcome.text: Hear ye, good people of Vesper! Welcome to the city of bridges. Keep the quays clear, and lend an ear to your neighbours.

welcome.speaker: crier
welcome.text: Good day, travellers. The Mint stands beside this square. Ask for news if you wish to know what is happening in town.

bank.speaker: crier
bank.text: The Mint keeps your valuables safe. Speak to the banker, or simply say bank when you are nearby.

bank.speaker: crier
bank.text: Travellers, the Mint serves both sides of its doorway. You need not crowd the counter to reach your bank box.

flavor.speaker: crier
flavor.text: Vesper is a city of traders, canals, and stone bridges. From the docks to the museum, every crossing has a story.

flavor.speaker: crier
flavor.text: For a quiet hour, visit the museum. For a warm welcome, seek the Ironwood Inn.

shortage.speaker: crier
shortage.text: News from the Marsh Hall! Garrick needs fresh fish for his kitchen. A patient angler can earn an honest supper.

shortage.speaker: crier
shortage.text: The Marsh Hall kitchen is short of fish. Anglers and helpful travellers, Garrick could use your catch.

fish_news.speaker: crier
fish_news.text: Fresh fish have reached the Marsh Hall! Corin has delivered his catch to Garrick. The kitchen is supplied again.

fish_news.speaker: crier
fish_news.text: Good news from the waterfront. Corin has kept his promise, and his fish have reached the tavern kitchen.

bread_news.speaker: crier
bread_news.text: Bread from the Twisted Oven has arrived at the Marsh Hall. Elowen has delivered Lysa's basket safely.

bread_news.speaker: crier
bread_news.text: A delivery well done! The tavern now has fresh bread, carried over the bridges by Elowen.

player_news.speaker: crier
player_news.text: A traveller has helped supply the Marsh Hall. Garrick sends his thanks for the fresh fish.

player_news.speaker: crier
player_news.text: News worth sharing: a visitor has brought fish to the tavern kitchen. Vesper remembers a helping hand.

museum_news.speaker: crier
museum_news.text: The museum's astrolabe has arrived! A traveller has completed Elowen's delivery and returned a piece of history to Vesper.

bread_open.speaker: crier
bread_open.text: The Twisted Oven sells warm bread for two gold a loaf. Ask Lysa when you reach her shop.

courier_request.speaker: crier
courier_request.text: Elowen, could you take a basket from Lysa to the Marsh Hall? The kitchen is short of bread.

courier_accept.speaker: elowen
courier_accept.text: I can help. I will collect the bread from Lysa, then carry it to Garrick.

courier_accept.speaker: elowen
courier_accept.text: Yes, I have room for a basket. I will go to the Twisted Oven first.

bread_pickup.speaker: elowen
bread_pickup.text: Lysa, I promised to take bread to the Marsh Hall. Is the basket ready?

bread_pickup.speaker: elowen
bread_pickup.text: I am here for Garrick's bread, Lysa. The bridges should be quiet enough now.

bread_handover.speaker: baker
bread_handover.text: Here you are, Elowen. Four fresh loaves, wrapped for the walk. Thank you for carrying them.

bread_handover.speaker: baker
bread_handover.text: The basket is ready. Mind the cloth; those loaves are still warm.

bread_arrival.speaker: elowen
bread_arrival.text: Garrick, I brought Lysa's bread. All four loaves, and not a crumb lost on the bridges.

bread_arrival.speaker: elowen
bread_arrival.text: A basket from the Twisted Oven. Lysa sends her regards, along with your bread.

bread_thanks.speaker: barkeep
bread_thanks.text: Thank you, Elowen. That is one promise kept and four good loaves in the kitchen.

bread_thanks.speaker: barkeep
bread_thanks.text: Set the basket here. Lysa's bread always brings people back to the table.

fish_offer.speaker: fisherman
fish_offer.text: Garrick, the catch is landed. I can bring three fresh fish to your kitchen.

fish_offer.speaker: fisherman
fish_offer.text: Three good fish in the basket. Shall I leave them with you, Garrick?

fish_thanks.speaker: barkeep
fish_thanks.text: Well caught, Corin. I will take the three fish. There is room for you at the table when your work is done.

fish_thanks.speaker: barkeep
fish_thanks.text: Fresh from the water. Thank you, Corin. These will do nicely for supper.

fish_promise.speaker: fisherman
fish_promise.text: Garrick needs fish. I will take this catch to the Marsh Hall before I cast again.

fish_promise.speaker: fisherman
fish_promise.text: Enough for a basket. I promised the tavern a catch, and I mean to keep that promise.

fish_work.speaker: fisherman
fish_work.text: A little patience. Watch the water, not the end of the rod.

fish_work.speaker: fisherman
fish_work.text: There is a good current along this quay. Let us see what it brings.

rest.speaker: fisherman
rest.text: A moment off my feet, then back to the water.

rest.speaker: fisherman
rest.text: The tide can wait while I catch my breath.

courier_report.speaker: elowen
courier_report.text: Osric, the bread reached Garrick safely. Lysa's basket is in the kitchen now.

report_ack.speaker: crier
report_ack.text: Thank you, Elowen. I will let the square know when the next notice is due.

social_hello.speaker: resident_living
social_hello.text: Good day, Elowen. You look as though you have crossed every bridge in Vesper.

social_hello.speaker: resident_living
social_hello.text: Elowen! Is there a quiet table at the Marsh Hall today?

social_reply.speaker: elowen
social_reply.text: More than a few bridges, Nessa. A warm meal will be welcome.

social_reply.speaker: elowen
social_reply.text: Garrick will find you a place. I am hoping to stop there myself.

meal_order.speaker: resident_living
meal_order.text: Garrick, may I have a little fish and bread? The walk has given me an appetite.

meal_served.speaker: barkeep
meal_served.text: Here you are, Nessa. Fresh fish and Lysa's bread. Take your time with it.

meal_thanks.speaker: resident_living
meal_thanks.text: That was just what I needed. Please thank the people who brought it in.

meal_empty.speaker: barkeep
meal_empty.text: I am waiting for supplies before I can serve that. Give me a little time.

baking.speaker: baker
baking.text: Another batch ready. There is nothing like the smell of a warm oven.

baking.speaker: baker
baking.text: A little flour on the sleeves is the mark of an honest morning.

greet_crier.speaker: crier
greet_crier.text: Good day. Ask me for news, services, or work. I only report what has reached my ears.

greet_fisherman.speaker: fisherman
greet_fisherman.text: Good day. I fish these quays and bring part of my catch to Garrick. Ask about work if you want to help.

greet_barkeep.speaker: barkeep
greet_barkeep.text: Welcome to the Marsh Hall. I buy fresh fish for three gold each. There is always work in keeping a kitchen supplied.

greet_baker.speaker: baker
greet_baker.text: Welcome to the Twisted Oven. A warm loaf is two gold. Elowen sometimes carries a basket over to the tavern for me.

greet_elowen.speaker: elowen
greet_elowen.text: Good to see you. Between museum deliveries and errands for the neighbours, there is always another bridge to cross.

greet_resident_living.speaker: resident_living
greet_resident_living.text: I am Nessa. I mend nets when there is work, and visit the Marsh Hall when my stomach insists.

greet_banker.speaker: banker
greet_banker.text: Welcome to the Mint. Say bank nearby, and I will open your box. Your valuables remain yours.

greet_joiner.speaker: joiner
greet_joiner.text: Good timber deserves careful hands. What brings you to my workshop?

greet_shipwright.speaker: shipwright
greet_shipwright.text: Mind your step in the yard. We have boats on the water and work on the bench.

greet_curator.speaker: curator
greet_curator.text: Welcome to Vesper Museum. Our city trades in many things, but memory is what we keep here.

greet_innkeeper.speaker: innkeeper
greet_innkeeper.text: Welcome to the Ironwood Inn. Rest a while. The bridges will still be here when you are ready.

greet_healer.speaker: healer
greet_healer.text: Take a breath, traveller. There is no charge for a little kindness.

player_help.speaker: barkeep
player_help.text: Bring one fish back here and say deliver fish. I will pay three gold when it is handed over.

player_accept.speaker: barkeep
player_accept.text: Then we have an agreement. One fish for the kitchen, three gold for your trouble. Come back when you have it.

player_delivered.speaker: barkeep
player_delivered.text: A fish for the kitchen, and three gold for you. Thank you for keeping your word.

player_no_fish.speaker: barkeep
player_no_fish.text: You have not brought a fish yet. Corin can show you where to cast a line.

player_no_promise.speaker: barkeep
player_no_promise.text: We have no delivery arranged yet. Ask about work, or use vendor sell to sell your catch.

player_remember.speaker: barkeep
player_remember.text: I remember your delivery. A kitchen runs on people who keep their word.

player_waiting.speaker: barkeep
player_waiting.text: I am still waiting for the fish you promised. No hurry; bring it when you have a catch.

unknown.speaker: crier
unknown.text: That is beyond my news today. Ask about news, services, or work, and I will help where I can.

work_direction.speaker: crier
work_direction.text: Ask Garrick at the Marsh Hall about work. He can offer a small fish delivery when the kitchen needs help.

no_news.speaker: crier
no_news.text: No fresh notice has reached me just now. I will speak when there is something worth sharing.

thanks.speaker: elowen
thanks.text: You are welcome. A little help makes these bridges feel shorter.

greet_neighbour_0.speaker: neighbour_0
greet_neighbour_0.text: I am Rowan. I copy the museum notices. A misplaced date can start a very old argument.

chat_neighbour_0.speaker: neighbour_0
chat_neighbour_0.text: I copy the museum notices. A misplaced date can start a very old argument.

chat_neighbour_0.speaker: neighbour_0
chat_neighbour_0.text: There is always another story to bring home.

reply_neighbour_0.speaker: neighbour_0
reply_neighbour_0.text: There is always another story to bring home.

reply_neighbour_0.speaker: neighbour_0
reply_neighbour_0.text: Good to see you. Safe travels across the bridges.

greet_neighbour_1.speaker: neighbour_1
greet_neighbour_1.text: I am Wren. Salt gets into everything by the canals. Even the cloth needs a little care.

chat_neighbour_1.speaker: neighbour_1
chat_neighbour_1.text: Salt gets into everything by the canals. Even the cloth needs a little care.

chat_neighbour_1.speaker: neighbour_1
chat_neighbour_1.text: Good company makes a long day shorter.

reply_neighbour_1.speaker: neighbour_1
reply_neighbour_1.text: Good company makes a long day shorter.

reply_neighbour_1.speaker: neighbour_1
reply_neighbour_1.text: Good to see you. Safe travels across the bridges.

greet_neighbour_2.speaker: neighbour_2
greet_neighbour_2.text: I am Hobb. I am learning a tune for the tavern. Best give me another week before you listen.

chat_neighbour_2.speaker: neighbour_2
chat_neighbour_2.text: I am learning a tune for the tavern. Best give me another week before you listen.

chat_neighbour_2.speaker: neighbour_2
chat_neighbour_2.text: I will remember that next time I cross the square.

reply_neighbour_2.speaker: neighbour_2
reply_neighbour_2.text: I will remember that next time I cross the square.

reply_neighbour_2.speaker: neighbour_2
reply_neighbour_2.text: Good to see you. Safe travels across the bridges.

greet_neighbour_3.speaker: neighbour_3
greet_neighbour_3.text: I am Mira. Keep a little room on the bridge. We all reach the other side faster that way.

chat_neighbour_3.speaker: neighbour_3
chat_neighbour_3.text: Keep a little room on the bridge. We all reach the other side faster that way.

chat_neighbour_3.speaker: neighbour_3
chat_neighbour_3.text: Take care on your way. I will keep an eye on this crossing.

reply_neighbour_3.speaker: neighbour_3
reply_neighbour_3.text: Take care on your way. I will keep an eye on this crossing.

reply_neighbour_3.speaker: neighbour_3
reply_neighbour_3.text: Good to see you. Safe travels across the bridges.

greet_neighbour_4.speaker: neighbour_4
greet_neighbour_4.text: I am Oren. I came here to mend books. I may stay for the view from the bridges.

chat_neighbour_4.speaker: neighbour_4
chat_neighbour_4.text: I came here to mend books. I may stay for the view from the bridges.

chat_neighbour_4.speaker: neighbour_4
chat_neighbour_4.text: A town is better when its people have time for one another.

reply_neighbour_4.speaker: neighbour_4
reply_neighbour_4.text: A town is better when its people have time for one another.

reply_neighbour_4.speaker: neighbour_4
reply_neighbour_4.text: Good to see you. Safe travels across the bridges.

greet_neighbour_5.speaker: neighbour_5
greet_neighbour_5.text: I am Jory. A sound hull starts with sound timber. Maren checks every plank I bring.

chat_neighbour_5.speaker: neighbour_5
chat_neighbour_5.text: A sound hull starts with sound timber. Maren checks every plank I bring.

chat_neighbour_5.speaker: neighbour_5
chat_neighbour_5.text: I had better keep moving. These parcels do not carry themselves.

reply_neighbour_5.speaker: neighbour_5
reply_neighbour_5.text: I had better keep moving. These parcels do not carry themselves.

reply_neighbour_5.speaker: neighbour_5
reply_neighbour_5.text: Good to see you. Safe travels across the bridges.

greet_neighbour_6.speaker: neighbour_6
greet_neighbour_6.text: I am Tessa. I make pots for people who use them. The prettiest one still needs to hold water.

chat_neighbour_6.speaker: neighbour_6
chat_neighbour_6.text: I make pots for people who use them. The prettiest one still needs to hold water.

chat_neighbour_6.speaker: neighbour_6
chat_neighbour_6.text: That sounds like a good reason to stop at the tavern.

reply_neighbour_6.speaker: neighbour_6
reply_neighbour_6.text: That sounds like a good reason to stop at the tavern.

reply_neighbour_6.speaker: neighbour_6
reply_neighbour_6.text: Good to see you. Safe travels across the bridges.

greet_neighbour_7.speaker: neighbour_7
greet_neighbour_7.text: I am Bram. Sella keeps a careful inn. Clean linen, warm water, and remedies within reach.

chat_neighbour_7.speaker: neighbour_7
chat_neighbour_7.text: Sella keeps a careful inn. Clean linen, warm water, and remedies within reach.

chat_neighbour_7.speaker: neighbour_7
chat_neighbour_7.text: I will see you again when my errands are done.

reply_neighbour_7.speaker: neighbour_7
reply_neighbour_7.text: I will see you again when my errands are done.

reply_neighbour_7.speaker: neighbour_7
reply_neighbour_7.text: Good to see you. Safe travels across the bridges.

greet_neighbour_8.speaker: neighbour_8
greet_neighbour_8.text: I am Ada. I mend clocks, but Vesper seems to run on tides and gossip.

chat_neighbour_8.speaker: neighbour_8
chat_neighbour_8.text: I mend clocks, but Vesper seems to run on tides and gossip.

chat_neighbour_8.speaker: neighbour_8
chat_neighbour_8.text: A moment to talk is time well spent.

reply_neighbour_8.speaker: neighbour_8
reply_neighbour_8.text: A moment to talk is time well spent.

reply_neighbour_8.speaker: neighbour_8
reply_neighbour_8.text: Good to see you. Safe travels across the bridges.

chat_crier.speaker: crier
chat_crier.text: News travels on feet in this town. Bring me facts, and I will give them a voice.

chat_crier.speaker: crier
chat_crier.text: Thank you for stopping. I keep an ear open for the neighbours.

reply_crier.speaker: crier
reply_crier.text: Thank you for stopping. I keep an ear open for the neighbours.

friend_crier.speaker: crier
friend_crier.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

chat_fisherman.speaker: fisherman
chat_fisherman.text: The water teaches patience. The kitchen teaches you not to waste a catch.

chat_fisherman.speaker: fisherman
chat_fisherman.text: Good company, and a little luck with the tide. That is enough for me.

reply_fisherman.speaker: fisherman
reply_fisherman.text: Good company, and a little luck with the tide. That is enough for me.

friend_fisherman.speaker: fisherman
friend_fisherman.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

chat_elowen.speaker: elowen
chat_elowen.text: Every errand is another reason to cross a bridge. I am getting to know them all.

chat_elowen.speaker: elowen
chat_elowen.text: I will look in again when my deliveries are finished.

reply_elowen.speaker: elowen
reply_elowen.text: I will look in again when my deliveries are finished.

friend_elowen.speaker: elowen
friend_elowen.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

chat_barkeep.speaker: barkeep
chat_barkeep.text: A warm table takes more than a fire. Someone has to bring the fish and bread.

chat_barkeep.speaker: barkeep
chat_barkeep.text: Come back when you have a moment. There is always company at the Marsh Hall.

reply_barkeep.speaker: barkeep
reply_barkeep.text: Come back when you have a moment. There is always company at the Marsh Hall.

friend_barkeep.speaker: barkeep
friend_barkeep.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

chat_baker.speaker: baker
chat_baker.text: People say bread brings a town together. I think they mostly mean the smell.

chat_baker.speaker: baker
chat_baker.text: Take care on the bridges. And do not forget to eat.

reply_baker.speaker: baker
reply_baker.text: Take care on the bridges. And do not forget to eat.

friend_baker.speaker: baker
friend_baker.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

chat_banker.speaker: banker
chat_banker.text: I count coins all morning. It is good to see a familiar face between the figures.

chat_banker.speaker: banker
chat_banker.text: Your bank box will be here when you need it.

reply_banker.speaker: banker
reply_banker.text: Your bank box will be here when you need it.

friend_banker.speaker: banker
friend_banker.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

chat_joiner.speaker: joiner
chat_joiner.text: A plank is a promise. It may become a chair, or carry someone safely over the sea.

chat_joiner.speaker: joiner
chat_joiner.text: Bring it by the workshop if it needs mending.

reply_joiner.speaker: joiner
reply_joiner.text: Bring it by the workshop if it needs mending.

friend_joiner.speaker: joiner
friend_joiner.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

chat_shipwright.speaker: shipwright
chat_shipwright.text: A boat is a thousand small jobs. Miss one, and the sea will find it.

chat_shipwright.speaker: shipwright
chat_shipwright.text: Safe steps on the quay. The water gives no second warning.

reply_shipwright.speaker: shipwright
reply_shipwright.text: Safe steps on the quay. The water gives no second warning.

friend_shipwright.speaker: shipwright
friend_shipwright.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

chat_healer.speaker: healer
chat_healer.text: Rest and a warm meal do more good than most people allow themselves.

chat_healer.speaker: healer
chat_healer.text: Look after yourself. Vesper has time for kindness.

reply_healer.speaker: healer
reply_healer.text: Look after yourself. Vesper has time for kindness.

friend_healer.speaker: healer
friend_healer.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

chat_innkeeper.speaker: innkeeper
chat_innkeeper.text: Travellers bring stories with their muddy boots. I could listen all evening.

chat_innkeeper.speaker: innkeeper
chat_innkeeper.text: There is a welcome at the Ironwood when your day is done.

reply_innkeeper.speaker: innkeeper
reply_innkeeper.text: There is a welcome at the Ironwood when your day is done.

friend_innkeeper.speaker: innkeeper
friend_innkeeper.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

chat_curator.speaker: curator
chat_curator.text: The smallest objects can tell the longest stories. That is why I keep them.

chat_curator.speaker: curator
chat_curator.text: Call at the museum when you have a quiet hour.

reply_curator.speaker: curator
reply_curator.text: Call at the museum when you have a quiet hour.

friend_curator.speaker: curator
friend_curator.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

chat_resident_living.speaker: resident_living
chat_resident_living.text: Mending nets is patient work. A good knot is worth doing twice.

chat_resident_living.speaker: resident_living
chat_resident_living.text: Perhaps I will see you at the tavern later.

reply_resident_living.speaker: resident_living
reply_resident_living.text: Perhaps I will see you at the tavern later.

friend_resident_living.speaker: resident_living
friend_resident_living.text: Good to see you again. I remember your help. People who keep their word are welcome here.

timber_collect.speaker: neighbour_5
timber_collect.text: Tomas, I have come for three planks for Maren. I will take them straight to the boatyard.

timber_give.speaker: joiner
timber_give.text: Three planks, dry and sound. Mind the ends when you cross the bridges.

timber_arrival.speaker: neighbour_5
timber_arrival.text: Maren, here is the timber from Tomas. Three planks, and all of them dry.

timber_thanks.speaker: shipwright
timber_thanks.text: Thank you, Jory. That is timber I can put to work.

remedies_collect.speaker: neighbour_7
remedies_collect.text: Anwen, Sella asked for two jars for the inn. I will carry them carefully.

remedies_give.speaker: healer
remedies_give.text: Here are the two jars. Keep the lids closed and tell Sella they are ready.

remedies_arrival.speaker: neighbour_7
remedies_arrival.text: Sella, the remedies have arrived. Two jars from Anwen, safely carried.

remedies_thanks.speaker: innkeeper
remedies_thanks.text: Thank you, Bram. I will keep them ready for our guests.

timber_news.speaker: crier
timber_news.text: Word from the boatyard. Jory has delivered timber from Tomas to Maren. Another errand safely done.

remedies_news.speaker: crier
remedies_news.text: News from the Ironwood Inn. Bram has brought Anwen's remedies to Sella. The jars arrived safely.

parcel_accept.speaker: joiner
parcel_accept.text: Take this plank to Maren at the Majestic Boat. Say deliver parcel when you arrive. Five gold for a careful delivery.

parcel_delivered.speaker: shipwright
parcel_delivered.text: The plank is sound. Here are five gold, and my thanks for carrying it.

friend_supper.speaker: barkeep
friend_supper.text: You have helped the neighbours. Let us do something for you. Fish and bread, on the house. Pull up a chair.
